Jahan feet hain, wahi bano.
"Jitni zyada mehnat, utni zyada luck."
Kuch bhi impossible nahi.
"Success failures par build hoti."
Sapna khud banao, nahi toh koi aur banayega.
Success hai khud ko pasand karna, jo kaam karte ho usse love karna, aur us tareeqe se pasand karna.
Lohha garam hone ka intezaar mat karo; usse maar kar hi garam karo.
Jo nahi kar sakte, usko mat allow karo—jo kar sakte woh karo.
Motivation shuru karwati hai. Habit chalaye rakhti hai.
